description: Deployment state now respects the CLI's effective `ASPIRE_HOME` instead of always writing to the persistent user profile, which was breaking isolated CI runs and side-by-side CLI usage. Deployment parameters and secrets are stored under `<ASPIRE_HOME>/deployments/<AppHostSha>/<environment>.json`, with `~/.aspire` retained as the fallback.
name: Honor ASPIRE_HOME for deployment state
